panels.gesture: A commanding focused expression, mouth open just enough to issue a clear order; one forearm points decisively to the side, shoulders square and upright.
Firm calm authority, steady forward gaze and closed mouth; one open palm raised toward the viewer in a clear stop gesture, the other hand relaxed low.
A stern furrowed brow, level eye contact, slightly open mouth; one upright index finger beside the chest delivering a measured warning, other arm lowered.
A cool fearless half-smile, chin slightly lifted and sharp focused eyes; arms confidently folded, powerful but controlled stance.
Controlled genuine anger, eyebrows tightly drawn, jaw firm, lips parted mid-rebuke; one clenched fist held near the shoulder, without distorting his face.
An inspiring vigorous rallying call, open mouth, determined bright eyes; one arm lifted diagonally in a compact rallying gesture with the hand fully inside its panel.
Solemn unwavering sincerity and direct blue-eyed gaze; one closed fist placed over the heart, the other arm at ease, no weapon.
Concern beneath composed authority, brows drawn and eyes briefly lowered; one hand rubbing the back of his neck, the other near the lower chest, no melodrama.
Steady protective confidence with a reassuring small smile; both open hands held low and gently angled downward in a calming gesture, shoulders relaxed but dignified.
